## Challenge

- [ ] Appended one case in `src/challenges/<category>.ts` (or added a new category file and registered it)
- [ ] Unique `id` of the form `<category>-NN`
- [ ] Realistic editing task, not an abstract cursor drill
- [ ] `initialContent` differs from `targetContent`
- [ ] At least one hint and an `intendedMove`
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Checked it in `npm run dev` via `?challenge=<id>`
